title: Claude Code Sprite Creation
author: Mountaindrowner
selftext:
I’m trying to produce better sprites and pixel characters by using a purely Claude code driven output pipeline. I’m losing my mind, I can’t get better than this.  
So I’ve been trying all kinds of different strategies.  
I’ve tried teaching it like a human, going through beginner info up.  
I’ve tried approaching it in a purely code perspective.  
I’ve tried a tool made specifically for this, based perspective.   
I’m not sure where else to go?

comments.author: enricokern
comments.body: Pixellab, sprite-art.ai etc. Self generate proper normal art and convert.

replies.author: Mountaindrowner
replies.body: So I’ve used pixel lab and it’s great, but I’m trying to go purely through Claude

replies.author: Icy-Cow-4426
replies.body: Can you explain how to convert?

comments.author: WestminsterNinja
comments.body: Claude isn't trained on stable diffusion type models, it's not going to be possible to do this.

replies.author: Mountaindrowner
replies.body: So are you saying that Claude’s abilities to code and map and basically create anything through code and pixels can’t do this? Am I overestimating the ability?

replies.author: Ianuarius
replies.body: The training data doesn't include typical picture generation.

replies.author: WestminsterNinja
replies.body: Just ask Claude if it's trained on Stable Diffusion and what that means, and it'll answer  all of your followup questions.

replies.author: Mountaindrowner
replies.body: But is stable diffusion the only way for AI to understand and create things like Sprite art?
